Method of Attack: Exploiting an unpatched vulnerability (CVE-2020-9332) in the bus driver that allows privilege escalation by adding fake USB devices
Using the insecure IoCreateDevice routine to create and control software devices trusted by the OS
Simulating USB devices such as fake mouse pointers to bypass User Account Control (UAC) and adding network cards to intercept traffic
Attack Vector: Local USB device redirection software vulnerability allowing non-privileged users to add and control virtual USB devices
Driver running under LocalSystem account with extensive privileges
